note: 后面接一个完整句子，比 I think 更正式。

examples.en: In my opinion, we should start earlier.
examples.zh: 在我看来，我们应该早点开始。

examples.en: In my opinion, reading is the best way to learn English.
examples.zh: 我认为阅读是学英语最好的方法。

phrase: I think it's a good idea to …
note: it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的 to do。

examples.en: I think it's a good idea to make a plan first.
examples.zh: 我认为先订个计划是个好主意。

examples.en: I think it's a good idea to help each other in class.
examples.zh: 我认为在课上互相帮助是个好主意。

note: agree with + 人/看法；同意某计划用 agree to。

examples.en: I agree with you. Teamwork is important.
examples.zh: 我同意你，团队合作很重要。

examples.en: I agree with you that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 我同意你的看法，熟能生巧。

note: 委婉地表示反对，比 I don't agree 客气。

examples.en: I'm afraid I can't agree. The plan costs too much.
examples.zh: 恐怕我不能同意，这个计划花费太大。

examples.en: I'm afraid I can't agree with you on this point.
examples.zh: 在这一点上恐怕我不能同意你。

note: 具体说明时用 It depends on + 名词。

examples.en: Will you go camping? — It depends.
examples.zh: 你去露营吗？——看情况。

examples.en: It depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 这要看天气。

note: 用来引出自己了解的信息，语气谨慎。

examples.en: As far as I know, the library opens at nine.
examples.zh: 据我所知，图书馆九点开门。

examples.en: As far as I know, he has never been late.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他从未迟到过。

note: sound 是系动词，后面接形容词。

examples.en: How about a picnic this Sunday? — That sounds great!
examples.zh: 这周日去野餐怎么样？——听起来不错！

examples.en: That sounds great. I'll bring some fruit.
examples.zh: 听起来不错，我带些水果。

note: 放在句首，用逗号隔开，表示坦诚。

examples.en: To be honest, I don't like the ending.
examples.zh: 说实话，我不喜欢这个结局。

examples.en: To be honest, I need more time to finish it.
examples.zh: 说实话，我需要更多时间完成它。

note: 后面跟动词原形，用来提建议，不是真的问原因。

examples.en: Why don't you ask your teacher for help?
examples.zh: 你为什么不去找老师帮忙呢？

examples.en: Why don't you have a rest? You look tired.
examples.zh: 你为什么不休息一下？你看起来很累。

note: You'd better + 动词原形；否定是 You'd better not …。

examples.en: You'd better see a doctor at once.
examples.zh: 你最好马上去看医生。

examples.en: You'd better not stay up late before an exam.
examples.zh: 考试前你最好不要熬夜。

note: about 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing。

examples.en: What about going swimming this afternoon?
examples.zh: 今天下午去游泳怎么样？

examples.en: What about your homework? Have you finished it?
examples.zh: 你的作业呢？做完了吗？

note: 后接动词 -ing；不介意回答 Of course not.

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
examples.zh: 你介意开一下窗吗？

examples.en: Would you mind speaking more slowly?
examples.zh: 你介意说得慢一点吗？

note: 指参加活动并出力；join 多指加入组织。

examples.en: I want to take part in the English singing contest.
examples.zh: 我想参加英语歌唱比赛。

examples.en: Many students take part in the school sports meeting.
examples.zh: 许多学生参加学校运动会。

note: with 后面接人或群体；get on 也可换成 get along。

examples.en: She gets on well with her classmates.
examples.zh: 她和同学们相处得很好。

examples.en: It's important to get on well with others.
examples.zh: 和他人友好相处很重要。

note: to 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing。

examples.en: Please pay attention to the teacher's words.
examples.zh: 请注意老师说的话。

examples.en: We should pay attention to our handwriting.
examples.zh: 我们应该注意自己的书写。

note: progress 不可数，不能说 a progress；常用 make great progress。

examples.en: You have made great progress in English this term.
examples.zh: 这学期你的英语进步很大。

examples.en: If you practise every day, you will make progress.
examples.zh: 如果每天练习，你就会进步。

note: at 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing。

examples.en: He is good at maths and physics.
examples.zh: 他擅长数学和物理。

examples.en: My sister is good at telling stories.
examples.zh: 我姐姐擅长讲故事。

note: 代词作宾语要放中间：look it up。

examples.en: When you meet a new word, look it up in a dictionary.
examples.zh: 遇到生词时，就在字典里查一下。

examples.en: I looked up the word in a dictionary but still didn't understand it.
examples.zh: 我在字典里查了这个词，但还是不明白。

note: 打电话找人用 speak to；介绍自己说 This is …。

examples.en: Hello, can I speak to Tom, please?
examples.zh: 你好，请问我可以和汤姆通话吗？

examples.en: Can I speak to the head teacher? This is Lucy's mother.
examples.zh: 我可以和校长通话吗？我是露西的妈妈。

note: 电话用语；也可以说 Hold on a moment.

examples.en: Hold on, please. I'll get him.
examples.zh: 请稍等，我去叫他。

examples.en: Hold on, please. The line is busy.
examples.zh: 请稍等，线路正忙。

note: Could you … 比 Can you … 更礼貌。

examples.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
examples.zh: 对不起，你能再说一遍吗？

examples.en: Could you say that again more slowly, please?
examples.zh: 你能再慢一点说一遍吗？

note: 常用 keep in touch with sb；写信结尾也常用。

examples.en: Let's keep in touch after we leave school.
examples.zh: 毕业后我们保持联系吧。

examples.en: We keep in touch by email.
examples.zh: 我们通过电子邮件保持联系。

note: to 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to your reply.
examples.zh: 我期待你的回复。

examples.en: We look forward to seeing you again.
examples.zh: 我们期待再次见到你。

note: for 后接名词；get ready to do 后接动词。

examples.en: We are getting ready for the final exam.
examples.zh: 我们正在为期末考试做准备。

examples.en: Get ready for the trip. We leave at eight.
examples.zh: 为旅行做好准备，我们八点出发。

note: home / there 前不加 to：on the way home。

examples.en: I met an old friend on the way to school.
examples.zh: 我在上学路上遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: She bought some flowers on the way home.
examples.zh: 她在回家路上买了一些花。

note: 介词短语，后面接名词或动词 -ing。

examples.en: Let's walk instead of taking a bus.
examples.zh: 我们走路去吧，别坐公交车了。

examples.en: He watched TV instead of doing his homework.
examples.zh: 他看电视而没有做作业。

note: one's 随主语变化：I try my best / She tries her best。

examples.en: I will try my best to help you.
examples.zh: 我会尽力帮助你。

examples.en: Just try your best and don't worry about the result.
examples.zh: 尽力就好，别担心结果。

note: 用于列举的第一条，后面常接 second / then。

examples.en: First of all, let's read the question carefully.
examples.zh: 首先，让我们仔细读题。

examples.en: First of all, I'd like to thank my parents.
examples.zh: 首先，我要感谢我的父母。

note: 在原有理由上再补充一条，用逗号隔开。

examples.en: The bike is cheap. What's more, it is easy to ride.
examples.zh: 这辆自行车很便宜，而且很好骑。

examples.en: What's more, we can learn a lot from books.
examples.zh: 此外，我们能从书中学到很多。

note: 用于结尾总结全文观点。

examples.en: In a word, health is more important than money.
examples.zh: 总之，健康比金钱更重要。

examples.en: In a word, we should protect our environment.
examples.zh: 总之，我们应该保护环境。

note: in 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing；主语变了 be 也要跟着变。

examples.en: I'm interested in science and technology.
examples.zh: 我对科学技术很感兴趣。

examples.en: She is interested in learning Japanese.
examples.zh: 她对学习日语很感兴趣。

note: of 后接名词或动词 -ing；口语里也常用 be afraid of。

examples.en: My little brother is scared of dogs.
examples.zh: 我弟弟怕狗。

examples.en: Don't be scared of making mistakes.
examples.zh: 别害怕犯错。

note: 直接宾语是代词时只能用这个结构：give it to him，不能说 give him it。

examples.en: Please give the book to your teacher.
examples.zh: 请把这本书交给老师。

examples.en: I gave my old bike to my cousin.
examples.zh: 我把旧自行车给了我表哥。

note: 双宾语结构，可改写成 give sth to sb；sth 是代词时优先用后一种。

examples.en: She gave me a birthday card.
examples.zh: 她送给我一张生日卡片。

examples.en: Can you give me a hand?
examples.zh: 你能帮我一下吗？

note: of 后接人或事；proud 是形容词，前面要有 be 动词。

examples.en: My parents are proud of my progress.
examples.zh: 父母为我的进步感到骄傲。

examples.en: We are proud of our city.
examples.zh: 我们为自己的城市感到自豪。

note: for 后接出名的原因或特点；be famous as 表示「作为……而闻名」。

examples.en: Shanghai is famous for its night views.
examples.zh: 上海以夜景闻名。

examples.en: The town is famous for its old bridges.
examples.zh: 这个小镇以古老的桥梁闻名。

note: make 后面的不定式不加 to；变成被动时要还原：be made to do sth。

examples.en: The teacher made us read the text aloud.
examples.zh: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。

examples.en: Don't make me wait too long.
examples.zh: 别让我等太久。

phrase: It takes sb some time to do sth
meaning: 做某事花费某人多少时间
note: it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的 to do；sb 和 some time 顺序固定。

examples.en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school.
examples.zh: 我步行上学要二十分钟。

examples.en: It took him three years to finish the book.
examples.zh: 他花了三年才写完这本书。
